knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The mission and an honest view of the present position come before channels, budgets and activities.
A claim about clients is an opinion until it is checked against a record or another source, so it should be marked and tested.
A measurable goal needs a baseline, a target, a date and a data source, so that progress can be checked.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes a mission of two or three sentences, tests it against one supplied decision, and writes one goal with a baseline, a target, a date and a data source for a supplied business scenario.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical criteria signed off separately by an assessor
evidenceRequired: Completed mission, present position and goal sheet saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats an opinion in the present position as a fact
Learner chooses a marketing channel before a goal with a baseline is written
